sources.title: Park ambience - mostly birds
sources.creator: Mafon2
sources.source_description: Recorded on digital camera, while in the park.
sources.reuse_terms: Source page explicitly declares CC0; copying, modification, redistribution and commercial use permitted; no attribution required.
sources.download_kind: Public HQ MP3 preview of the original field recording, not the login-only WAV original.
sources.notes: Use only where a daylight outdoor setting supports birds; no sound in exterior space. File exceeds film duration so no repeat seam is needed; apply short start/end fades and required reveal duck. Do not describe it as a specific city/plaza recording.

technical_review.sample_validity: finite nonempty PCM16 WAV, 48kHz; unclipped sample peaks measured
technical_review.speech_check: Local cached faster-whisper-small unprompted with VAD produced no speech segments for either full recording. This is evidence of no detected speech, not a listening certification.
technical_review.listening: No subjective listening available in this setup. Naturalness, embedded music, room character and park appropriateness still require listening review when available.
technical_review.sync: For a contact at film time C and source/listener distance d meters, place clip start at C + d/343 - transient_offset_s. A close clap-a offset is0.0229375s; largest sample occurs0.0286458333s into the clip.
technical_review.missing: No crowd speech, gasp or breath recording is claimed. These are optional for this film.
technical_review.promoted_assets: Four production WAVs are byte-identical copies under assets/library/audio/; hashes verified.
